req_name: Teardown releases every model, context and adapter handle
Every decode path honours cooperative cancellation within one token
Sampler chain construction has a fixed order and default-preserving gating
Named grammars are registered, validated, and resolved by a fixed precedence
Every declared grammar source reaches the sampler and exactly one wins
Tool staging drives a native render whose parse context is captured
One template-first / adapter-second rule parses every raw emission
Reasoning-block markers are declared once per model family
Adapter registry resolves a family parser with a safe generic fallback
Sequential tool-call mode hard-stops at the first closed call
MTP speculative decode fails loud and never silently falls back
Speculative decoding is gated on compatibility and must not change the output
Tier routing, handoff rules and secondary model roles
Per-tier sampler configuration applies only where the caller did not decide
LoRA adapters hot-swap under a single-HOT-per-context constraint
Backends declare capabilities and expose state and log-probability introspection
Multimodal input is bounded, tier-gated and degrades gracefully
MCPServerBase holds the shared logic; concrete servers override only deltas
Tool results always cross boundaries as a ServerResponse JSON envelope
ToolRegistry dispatch is defensive about unknown and null tools
Plugin C ABI is pure C, version-locked, and exported under hidden visibility
Configured plugins load loudly or fail loudly — never silently skipped
Plugin instances get serialised calls and ordered teardown
Tool calls route by server prefix uniformly across all three server kinds
Plugin tools are argument-validated on the same terms as built-ins
Operator permission gate with deny precedence and server-derived patterns
Per-identity MCP key authorization is opt-in but default-deny once enabled
Every tool declares its required access level, defaulting to WRITE
Tool calls pass an ordered precondition pipeline with typed rejection kinds
Tool arguments are validated against the declared JSON schema before dispatch
A locked tier's allowed_tools list is enforced at dispatch time
Duplicates, errors, and denials return corrective guidance, not bare failure
Anti-spiral tracking warns softly then hard-blocks repeated identical tools
PRE/POST_TOOL_CALL hooks fire on every exit path and POST may rewrite the result
Tool results are size-capped with a marker and classified into typed kinds
A bounded, thread-safe ring buffer retains recent tool calls for introspection
Filesystem tools are root-confined, read-before-write gated, and size-bounded
Glob, grep, and read honour .gitignore plus .explorerignore semantics
Bash and git servers gate on operator approval, not command pattern matching
Engine-level entropic.* tools validate their arguments and emit typed directives
External servers are discovered safely, directive-stripped, and health-monitored
Untrusted bytes are sanitized at ingress, never at egress
Sentinel count members bound enum validity and force exhaustive wiring
